title: DelegationInviteCreate
description: Create a delegation invite. Backend generates a single-use token and emails the accept link.

allowedScopes.description: Upper bound of scopes the MSP may receive.

expiresAt.description: Explicit expiry. If omitted, a default TTL (e.g., 7 days) is applied.

mspOrgSlug.description: Optional directed invite target (MSP org slug; equals Organization.slug, immutable). If omitted, it's an open invite.
